independence.statement: Fresh independent reviewer; did not design, implement, author tests, perform RCA, or delegate this task.

findings.category: spec and quality / missing required verification
findings.scenario: The frozen task explicitly requires controlled-Promise coverage of out-of-order completion. The only pending-Promise case starts a single guard call and resolves that same call; the negative matrix supplies pre-mutated observations to separate, sequential invocations. No test creates overlapping requests and resolves them in reverse order, so it cannot detect a cross-request binding or dispatch mix-up in that scenario. The 31 passing RED controls used the nonfunctional fallback and do not establish the missing behavior. Code inspection indicates per-call state, but it cannot replace the expressly required test evidence.
findings.remediation: Have the implementer add a meaningful controlled overlapping-request reverse-completion case that checks each request, READY identity and dispatch independently, then retain appropriate runner evidence and submit the resulting candidate for independent review.
